set.body:
## Scope
Provide bounded, read-only remote ledger reads and commit-pinned campaign-history deltas. Import missing activity through durable checkpoints when an operation was accepted before the client wrote campaign history or journal presentation events.

Recovery is evidence collection only. It must never call an operation that can submit, apply, drive, retry, cancel, validate, or otherwise mutate remote state.

## Acceptance criteria
- Recovery reconciles an accepted submission that precedes campaign history without creating a duplicate task, retry, or replacement.
- Lost-response reconciliation normalizes array-task scheduler matches to the parent array before uniqueness checks and binding construction; packed and array accounting stays exact.
- Imported facts retain ledger/commit provenance and original timing, with an explicit recovery/import record rather than invented history.
- A recovery run resumes from a durable checkpoint and remains idempotent after crash or repeated invocation.
- Spy tests prove recovery makes zero calls to all submission-capable and validation-capable APIs.
- Bounded reads have documented maximum records/bytes and report source unavailability or truncated history as a visible gap/attention state.
set.title: A2.2: recover activity passively from ledgers and commit-pinned campaign history
